title: The Ice Cream Van At 3AM (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, an ice cream van sold you your favourite memory. And then you didn't have it anymore.
You run outside. The van is still there. The man is still smiling.
"Back so soon? Most people wait till they're older."
"Give it back," you say. "My memory. Give it back."
He laughs. "No refunds, buddy. But I can sell you another one."
He points at the menu. New flavours. Your first day of school. Your best friend's laugh.
Every one of them is yours.
You realise the van isn't selling memories. It's buying them.
And the freezer is full of jars. Thousands of them. With names on them.
You see one with your grandma's name.
At home, you open the jar.
The kitchen fills with the smell of her cooking. You hear her humming.
You haven't heard that song in ten years. You cry. Happy tears.
Then there's a knock at the door.
*It's your grandma. Smiling. Holding a jar with your name on it.
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
